name: Camp Nokomis
description_short: Overnight YMCA camp for girls ages 8-16 on Bear Island in Lake Winnipesaukee, NH, with two-week sessions. Campers choose from sports, waterfront and craft activities and live in cabins of 8-12 campers with two staff.
refund_policy_summary: A $300 deposit per two-week session is due at registration. It is non-refundable and can't be moved to another session, season or sibling. The full balance is due by April 1, 2027, with a $150 late fee after that date. After April 1, 2027, tuition is non-refundable and non-transferable. Refunds are only given for a documented illness of the camper or the death of an immediate family member. Cancellations must be emailed to campinfo@mvymca.org.
special_needs_notes: The camp can accommodate most dietary preferences (vegetarian, gluten-free, etc.), and staff are told about identified food allergies. No information on support for disabilities or other special needs.
swim_waterfront_notes: Island camp on Lake Winnipesaukee with two beaches. Swim instruction for all levels, plus canoeing, kayaking, rowing, sailing, waterskiing and windsurfing. Many staff are certified lifeguards.

warnings: Registration opens on different dates for different groups: returning campers and siblings on Oct 14, 2026; waitlisted campers from last season on Oct 21, 2026; new campers on Oct 28, 2026 (all at 9:00am). Because of this, registration_opens_at is left blank for the sessions.
Two consecutive sessions must be either 1 & 2 or 3 & 4.
Dramatics is listed as 'Available to 4 or 8 week campers only'. Ropes, Volleyball and Silvercraft are limited to older age groups.
Phone registration uses a different number (978-975-1330, the camping services office in Andover, MA) from the camp's main phone.
The page footer says © 2025, but the rates and dates are clearly marked for Summer 2027.
